title: Reversed invoices stay out of Sales By Customer with both types selected
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Today {Customer-A} has one invoiced work order and one invoice that was reversed.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Make sure both Sales Type options are selected and read {Customer-A}'s row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: only the invoiced work order counts; the reversed invoice is not a row and adds nothing to any count or total.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S8-N1, read 19 Oct 2026. "SBC (Sales By Customer) Report" spec, Confluence 577634305, version 21 (6 Oct 2026), S7-N2, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), pages 4 and 5 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1: “No Sales By Customer figure, row or count changes because of the new wording.”
  • Sales By Customer spec, S7-N2: “A reversed or voided invoice never appears as an invoice row and never adds to any count or total, even with both Sales Type options selected.”
